title: A flat ring map induces flat local maps of local rings
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] of commutative rings, $\mathfrak q\subset S$ a prime ideal and $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$. Then the induced map of localizations [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] $\varphi_{\mathfrak q}:R_{\mathfrak p}\to S_{\mathfrak q}$, $r/s\mapsto\varphi(r)/\varphi(s)$, is a flat local homomorphism of local rings: it is flat and maps $\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$ into $\mathfrak qS_{\mathfrak q}$. If moreover $R$ and $S$ are Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], then $R_{\mathfrak p}$ and $S_{\mathfrak q}$ are Noetherian local rings.
